title: Messi helps Inter Miami clinch MLS playoff berth with 2-0 win over NYCFC
description:
Rodrigo De Paul scored on an assist from Lionel Messi and German Berterame added a goal to send reigning champion Inter Miami back to the MLS playoffs with a 2-0 win over New York City FC on Wednesday night.
Luis Suarez also assisted for Inter Miami, which has won back-to-back matches for the first time since July.
Miami missed the postseason when Messi arrived in 2023, but has reached the playoffs the past three seasons, losing in the first round to Atlanta United in 2024 then beating Vancouver last year to win the club's first MLS Cup.
Wednesday's victory came after Miami routed DC United 4-0 last Saturday on a pair of goals from Messi and Suarez, and it was the second league win for new coach Cristian "Kily" Gonzalez, who took over Sept. 16.
